To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
high quality DWNTs were synthesized by decomposition over cobalt nanoparticles supported on porous magnesium oxide nanoparticles.
the DWNTs synthesized over MgO-supported Co nanoparticles are of very high quality, clean, and can be purified to remove impurities such as MgO and Co.
high quality DWNTs can be produced in high yield and purity by a CVD method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of clean DWNTs and separation of them from the catalysts.
the development of a simple and efficient method for synthesizing DWNTs with high purity and high quality.
the development of a novel method for the synthesis of clean DWNTs with high purity and the separation of the DWNTs from the catalyst and other carbonaceous impurities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the DWNTs grown on MgO catalysts have a very good potential for applications in the field of electronics, sensors, and energy storage.
the DWNTs were successfully purified by the present procedure.
the use of MgO as catalyst support is very effective for the production of high quality DWNTs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the synthesis of clean DWNTs by CVD is possible.
DWNTs can be grown with high purity by using MgO-supported Co catalysts, but the purification of DWNTs is a challenge.
the synthesis of clean DWNTs with high quality is possible by using a proper catalyst and the separation of the as-grown nanotubes from the catalysts and other impurities can be achieved.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of MgO as a support for the catalyst is a very promising approach for the growth of clean DWNTs with high graphitization.
it is possible to grow clean double-walled carbon nano-tubes with clean inner walls and outer walls, and clean inner and outer channels.
it is possible to grow DWNTs in large quantities with high purity and quality using a simple, inexpensive, and scalable method.
